documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for BZA Case #2025-03: Warfield Companies variance request to reduce PEC land use percentage minimums for office/industrial and retail/service categories. Staff recommends denial citing lack of hardship and conflict with PEC district employment objectives.

documents.name: Process and Opening Statement
documents.synopsis: Process and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-03 (Warfield variance request), outlining procedural rules for the October 29, 2025 hearing.

documents.name: Application
documents.original_filename: BZA Case 2025 03 Cover Letter and Application
documents.synopsis: BZA application filed by Warfield Companies for Case #2025-03, requesting variance from PEC land use percentage requirements in §180-139. Property is Warfield at Historic Sykesville, ~90.57 acres, PEC zone, Tax Map 200, Block 5.

documents.name: Warfield Concept Plan with Variance
documents.synopsis: Warfield concept plan dated September 2, 2025, submitted with the BZA variance request (Case #2025-03) showing proposed land use layout under the requested reduced PEC percentages.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for BZA Case #2025-02: appeal of the Planning Commission's July 7, 2025 unanimous denial of the Warfield Concept Plan for re-subdivision. Staff recommends denial of appeal; PC acted within authority citing §180-139 land use percentage violations.

documents.name: Process and Opening Statement
documents.synopsis: Process and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-02 (Warfield PC appeal), outlining procedural rules for the October 29, 2025 hearing.

documents.name: Application
documents.original_filename: BZA Case 2025 02 Cover Letter and Application
documents.synopsis: BZA application by Warfield Companies for Case #2025-02, appealing the Planning Commission's July 7, 2025 denial of the Warfield Concept Plan for re-subdivision of Warfield Commerce and Cultural Center as arbitrary, capricious, and legally erroneous.

documents.name: Planning Commission Letter to Applicant re: Denial of Concept Plan
documents.original_filename: Letter to applicant  Denial of Concept Plan
documents.synopsis: August 7, 2025 letter from Planning Commission Chair Phil Singleton to Warfield Companies confirming the PC's July 7, 2025 denial of the Warfield Concept Plan for re-subdivision and the bases for that decision.

documents.name: Letter from Town Lawyer re: Jurisdiction
documents.original_filename: 2025 1021 Letter to BZA   jurisdiction over applications
documents.synopsis: October 21, 2025 letter from Town Attorney Elissa Levan (Levan Ruff, LLC) advising the BZA that it lacks jurisdiction over Cases #2025-02 (PC appeal) and #2025-04 (Town Manager appeal). BZA may only hear appeals of administrative officials, not PC decisions or ministerial TM acts.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for BZA Case #2025-04: appeal of the Town Manager's August 28, 2025 determination that Warfield's Parcel B site development plan requires a full three-step PEC amendment process. Staff recommends denial; §180-144(B) leaves no discretion.

documents.name: Process and Opening Statement
documents.synopsis: Process and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-04 (Warfield Town Manager appeal), outlining procedural rules for the October 29, 2025 hearing.

documents.name: Application
documents.synopsis: BZA application by Warfield Companies for Case #2025-04, appealing the Town Manager's August 28, 2025 letter requiring the full PEC three-step approval process for the Parcel B site development plan.

documents.name: Letter from Town Manager to Applicant
documents.synopsis: August 28, 2025 letter from Town Manager to Warfield Companies advising that any amendment to the Warfield PEC plan must go through the full three-step process (Concept, Preliminary, Final) per §180-144(B).

documents.name: Agenda
documents.synopsis: Board of Zoning Appeals agenda for October 29, 2025. Three Warfield cases: variance request (2025-03) to reduce PEC land use minimums, appeal of PC concept plan denial (2025-02), and appeal of Town Manager process determination (2025-04). Staff recommends denial of all three.
